_comment: H2/O2: 9 species, 28 reactions. The same program as the grimech case, with a different mechanism compiled in and different numbers here.
_comment_balancer: 9 species means a cheap right hand side, so the extra derivatives() call rhsNorm and stiffness cost is worth less here than for grimech; temperature alone is the better trade. 'none' turns the ordering off entirely, which is the honest thing to compare against.

controls._comment: a 9x9 Jacobian is far better conditioned than a 53x53 one, so a tighter relative tolerance costs little

run._comment: the scratch of one thread grows as systemSize^2, so 9 species leave room for many more reactors at once than 53 do
